headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 4, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Chicago Cubs, securing a 17-1 victory. Masyn Winn led the Cardinals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 4 runs. The Washington Nationals secured a 9-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Foster Griffin earning the win. Daylen Lile led the Pirates' offense with 3 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs. The New York Yankees secured a 5-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Gerrit Cole earning the win after 5.0 innings of work, striking out 7 batters and allowing 2 earned runs. Trent Grisham led the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBI.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, affecting their teams' lineups. Freddy Fermin of the San Diego Padres has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a head contusion. Randy Vásquez of the San Diego Padres has been placed on the 15-day injured list with a right ankle contusion. Julio Rodríguez of the Seattle Mariners has been placed on the 7-day injured list with a concussion. Cooper Criswell of the Seattle Mariners has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with a right shoulder strain. Ryan Helsley of the Baltimore Orioles has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 30 with right elbow discomfort.

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros in exchange for cash. The Baltimore Orioles have traded right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas to the Washington Nationals for shortstop Randal Diaz.
